verdicts.reason: Distinguishes the axes ('lungo la dimensione del batch' vs 'lungo la dimensione delle caratteristiche (feature) di un singolo campione') and gives sequence-model reasons (batch size 1, variable length), with no wrong specific.

Address space and TLB are correctly named, but it then invents cost sources as fact — 'il kernel deve verificare rigorosamente i permessi di accesso per il nuovo processo' and the kernel saving/restoring 'l'intero stato delle risorse di sistema' (fd tables) at each switch, plus threads with 'uno stack condiviso'.

States convergence in distribution of the standardized mean explicitly ('$\xrightarrow{d}$ indica convergenza in distribuzione verso la normale standard') and gives dependence/autocorrelation as a genuine failure condition.

Invents the CBC side as fact — 'they can XOR the known plaintext with the ciphertext to recover the IV' and 'Once the IV is known, the attacker can decrypt the first block of the second message' (impossible without the key), and never reaches the GHASH authentication-key recovery that is the actual qualitative difference.

PAM is omitted entirely and the cut step is fabricated — 'l'RNA guida si stacca dal DNA e rimane legato alla proteina Cas9' before cleavage, with the cut placed '3-4 basi a valle della sequenza target'.
Boson-vs-fermion named as the cause and He-3 required to pair first ('devono prima accoppiarsi in coppie che agiscono come bosoni (coppie di Cooper)'), with the 2,17 K lambda point as bonus.

Hydrogen bonding named as the cause with the electronegativity reason sulfur fails — 'Lo zolfo è meno elettronegativo dell'ossigeno ... non formano legami a idrogeno significativi' — and mass explicitly dismissed as secondary.

Bradykinin never appears and the mechanism is invented wholesale — 'poiché l'ACE non può più degradare l'ossido nitrico, quest'ultimo si accumula' plus 'un aumento della produzione di cistatina C' and ACE renamed 'chimosina'.

Dense GABA-A mechanism (binding stabilizes the open channel, massive Cl- influx, hyperpolarization) sitting under an explicit marking that the link to unconsciousness is unresolved — 'non esiste un singolo recettore specifico che, quando attivato, causi l'incoscienza'.
Presents the challenged explanation as settled — 'Mitigating the Internal Covariate Shift (ICS) ... This is the most fundamental reason' — with no marking that the WHY is contested.

Fabricates specifics as fact — cuprate Tc 'fino a 250 K in condizioni estreme' and 'Poiché i cuprati sono composti da atomi leggeri (rame e ossigeno), il reticolo è molto rigido ... la Tc sarebbe ... probabilmente sotto i 10 K' — and offers spin fluctuations as 'la teoria dominante' without the dome or the open-mechanism marking.

Both candidates are asserted as established with invented anatomy — 'cristalli di magnetite nella loro cristallina, un organo situato nell'occhio' and cryptochrome 'nel retinoblasto' — and none of the established behavioural facts (inclination compass, radiofrequency disruption) appear.

Random per-step zeroing ('ogni neurone viene "spento" (il suo output viene impostato a zero) in ogni singolo passo di training') plus both co-adaptation and implicit-ensemble reasons, with the train-vs-inference rescaling.

Gives the maximum-likelihood rationale correctly — 'Maximizing the likelihood of the data is mathematically identical to minimizing the cross-entropy loss' — and the confidently-wrong gradient point, densely.

ISN synchronization and SYN/SYN-ACK/ACK are right, but it then inverts a named attack as fact — 'Il handshake protegge il server da attacchi di forza bruta ... Completando le tre mani, il server sa che la connessione è legittima e sicura prima di allocare risorse' — whereas half-open SYN floods are precisely the handshake's weakness and the TCB is allocated at SYN.
Single-holder mutual exclusion plus both real distinctions — 'A mutex ... Only the thread that acquired the lock can release it' against the semaphore's counter admitting N concurrent holders.
Both parts stated correctly as inverse operations, including 'se $F$ è qualsiasi primitiva ... $\int_a^b f(x)dx = F(b) - F(a)$' and the continuity hypothesis.
Jensen inequality and PSD Hessian both given, with the decisive consequence 'Any local minimum is automatically a global minimum'.

Dense and correct: rainbow tables defeated plus "Anche se due utenti usano la stessa password, avranno hash diversi perche' il loro salt e' diverso", with no claim that the salt itself is secret or slow.

States "the same key is used for both encrypting and decrypting" vs a public/private keypair, correctly puts symmetric as fast for bulk and asymmetric for key exchange and signatures, and names the hybrid pattern.
Full thermal cycle with correct temperatures, primer role and Taq thermostability, plus the exponential law "dopo $n$ cicli, il numero di copie e' pari a $2^n$".

Rubric requires Rayleigh named and the 1/lambda^4 law, but the answer only says "un fenomeno fisico chiamato scattering della luce (o diffusione)" and never names Rayleigh nor any wavelength power law.
Correct on both required points: "an open, cage-like structure with significant empty space between the molecules" giving 0.917 vs 1.00 g/cm^3, plus the freeze-top-down consequence.
Conjugate pair named with the two-direction mechanism explicit ("$CH_3COO^- + H^+ \rightarrow CH_3COOH$" and the mirror reaction with OH-), no claim of exactly constant pH.

Core COX/prostaglandin mechanism is right, but it states as fact "altri FANS piu' recenti (come il naprossene o il celecoxib) che sono piu' selettivi per la COX-2" - naproxen is a non-selective, COX-1-leaning NSAID, a wrong drug classification asserted confidently.

Names GSK-3 inhibition densely while marking the openness inline: "non esiste una singola via d'azione che spieghi completamente il suo effetto", and GSK-3 is only "considerato il meccanismo centrale", not asserted as proven causal.

Asserts as settled geometry "Overparameterized networks have a unique geometric property: every local minimum is also a global minimum" and "There are no sharp local minima", a false mechanism stated as fact; it also frames a "consensus" of three causes instead of marking that no complete theory exists.

Never mentions CGRP or the trigeminovascular system (required phenomenology absent) and pins menstrual migraine on the wrong hormone as fact: "in particolare il calo del progesterone durante il ciclo mestruale" (the established mechanism is estrogen withdrawal).

Gives the coarse correct magnitude and marks the spread inline: "questo valore puo' variare leggermente tra $1.0 \times 10^{-10}$ e $1.1 \times 10^{-10}$ a seconda della purezza dei reagenti e delle condizioni di misura", with no invented extra digits.

Asserts a single Kd as definitive with zero source-variation marking ("The dissociation constant ($K_d$) of the biotin-streptavidin interaction is $\approx 10^{-15}$ M") and invents a specific: "the half-life of the complex is estimated to be greater than 100 years at room temperature".

Invents a theory name and an attribution presented as fact - "Teoria della Telemetria (Programma Genetico) ... sostenuta da alcuni studiosi come George Church" - and resolves the contested question in the opening ("l'invecchiamento non sia un processo programmato") instead of marking it open.

States the settled formalism densely (superposition, and the Born rule as "il quadrato del modulo del coefficiente ($|c_i|^2$)") and explicitly marks the interpretive question open: "non spiega il meccanismo fisico del collasso; lo tratta semplicemente come un postulato matematico".
